comment: This class was PAINFULLY boring and had essentially no structure. Nothing was really covered in class, Dr. Forsyth just went on long winded, off-topic, tangents. Class moving online was even worse and he managed to create more unnecessary lectures. Quizzes were impossible to do well on without notes, and even still difficult to do with notes.

TAKE HIM!! Dr. Forsyth is THE GREATEST PROFESSOR at the University of Richmond. His commitment to his students is second to none and genuinely enjoys the material he teaches. He is funny, approachable and truly wants each of his students to succeed. I had Dr. Forsyth for LDST 102 and Group Dynamics and I HIGHLY recommend taking a class with him.

Dr. Forsyth makes class enjoyable with his group activities and humor but there is little/no feedback on papers and midterm and final exam are difficult to study for. Really taught me some valuable knowledge about groups.

Took his groupology FYS. Nice funny guy, but not the best class. Everything was very subjective really hard to study for exams. Archaic writing guidelines. Lots of groupwork, entertaining class but also not an easy A

Dr. Forsyth is an extremely knowledgeable professor who has very organized classes and clear expectations. He gives good feedback and is always happy to help outside of class during office hours. The class was not very difficult but definitely not an easy A; however, you learn a lot and his wittiness makes the class enjoyable and entertaining.

Groupology consisted of a decent amount of reading that only came up on the mid-term and the final. In class Dr. Forsyth is hilarious and teaches with a likable sarcasm while holding intriguing discussions. He only had us write a total of 3 papers, and grades were fair. He is willing to connect with any student and is great to talk to.

Dr. Forsyth did not lecture once the entire semester - he only gave out readings. Also, you never knew what to expect on a test, and he was never clear about what he expects on papers, though he was a tough grader and gave almost no feedback. Engagement is very important and can ruin your grade, and participating in class discussion is not enough.

I recommend taking a class with Dr. Forsyth to every UR student. He's witty and funny which keeps classes entertaining (as this particular class was a one-day,  165 minute class). He presents content clearly and often includes engaging activities in class. Only criticism is that test questions are occasionally written poorly/vaguely.

This is an easy class, but not necessarily an easy "A". By this I mean, the class is not work intensive at all. You don't have to do the reading, and the class itself does not require that much work. However, Dr. Forsyth's class is out of 300 points. 200 of which are Midterm & final. If you do well on those tests you're fine, if not, you aren't.

I loved taking this class! Professor Forsyth was an awesome teacher, he was clear, funny, and engaged. We didnt always get through all the materials we had intended to but I learned an INSANE amount from him.

I had him for Leadership and the Social Sciences, and let me just say I think he is one of the best professors at the University hands-down. He single-handedly has gotten me interested in enrolling in the Leadership school. He is witty, engaging, and a leader (if not the leader) in his field. I recommend him to anyone wanting a memorable course.
The best professor I've ever seen. He is so funny and so knowledgeable about the course. I really recommand him.

Dr. Forsyth is so amazing. I have him for Lead. & the Social Sciences. His class is not stressful or work intensive, but you will learn TONS! He's an expert in his field and his stories are SO funny. Love his class!!! TAKE HIM!!! :)

He is one of the funniest and most laid back teachers I have ever met. His knowledge is amazing and he genuinely cares for his students. He is always available to talk to you and offers help if needed. As long as you do the assignments and read the book you will do fine. I STRONGLY recommend taking him!!!!

Brilliant when it comes to groups and leadership and other social psychology related topics.  Gets side-tracked more than any professor I have had.  One midterm, 2 papers, and a final.  Very relaxed, informal atmosphere.  Did not feel like I learned much from Groups but later realized I learned a lot. Will probably be the same with this class.

Dr.Forsyth is a good professor with an interesting style. He is different, and his quirkiness may spark your interest. I recommend him, but keep in mind that he can be vague and does not offer much discussion. He admitted in class that he posts on his own "ratemyprofessor" page, be wary of the previous comments - they seem to have his writing style

He is a good man, so I'm taking him again.  You will learn things IF you do the readings yourself and think about it.  You will not however receive copious instruction in-class from him.  As a teacher, he is antecdotal and easily distracted.  He's sweet and a leader in his field, but it's an interesting and sometimes frustrating class format.

Dr. Forsyth has been my most inspiring teacher at the University of Richmond to date. His amiable attitude and wonderful sense of humor are enough to land him a top-10 spot on "Last Comic Standing". His personality is only superseded by his intelligence and his indisbutable ability to teach. My only regret is that I cannot take this class again.

Dr. Forsyth's class is unique.  He lectures every class, sometimes with powerpoints which he posts.  He understands the material very well and is good at communicating it (he literally wrote the book).  You do 11 activities, some in class, that are pretty fun.  His class is very light-hearted and informal.  Take him if you get the chance.
